children: Flare activates its go-flare v1.15.1 hard fork on 11 November 2026 at 14:00 UTC to patch a vulnerability in upstream node code. Validators and node operators must install go-flare v1.15.1 before the upgrade activates.
The upgrade follows a flagged exploit attempt. Timely validator updates are required for the network to continue operating when the hard fork activates. User funds are stated to be unaffected.

Flare is rolling out go-flare v1.15.1, a network upgrade that patches a vulnerability in the upstream code used by Flare nodes. The fix has already been tested. The hard fork activates on Nov 11 at 14:00 UTC. Validators and node operators: please upgrade as soon as possible.

title: Flare: go-flare v1.15.1 hard fork patches a node vulnerability - 11 Nov 2026
